acceptance: Credential regions yield no text and values are never read; secret-shaped text is redacted at capture and when it appears later; account text is flagged, stays local and is withheld from shared evidence; diagnostics hold codes and numbers only; nothing leaves the page.

positive.fixture: 6 browser tests with planted passwords, tokens, keys, personal data and a shadow-hosted credential region

negative.fixture: no planted secret appears in any batch, shared evidence or diagnostics; no fetch, XHR or beacon and no request outside the page origin

security_and_source_permissions: The observer reads structure and declared labels only; form values are never read, credential regions yield no text, account text is flagged and withheld from shared evidence, and no network surface exists.
performance_memory_storage: Classification is a few selector and regex checks per element.
known_limitations: Personal-data detection is heuristic; explicit data-vsf-scope markers are authoritative
